variants.headline: Still in view: a new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a new government comprising {members}.
variants.body:
A new government comprising {members} has been formed. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

Our principles do not become less demanding when an administration is assembled. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Still in view: formation is the beginning of governing
variants.sub: Government formation has produced an administration comprising {members}.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Still in view: new ministry, practical obligations

variants.body:
